sources.name: Player's Handbook Chapter 8
sources.reference: Player's Handbook p. 126-128; Table P28 and Table P29.

rules: Achievement points determine achievement level and become skill points when the hero reaches a new level. Source: Player's Handbook p. 126; Table P28 p. 128.
Achievement benefits are purchased with skill points once the hero reaches the listed achievement level. Source: Player's Handbook p. 127-128; Table P29 p. 128.
The Gamemaster awards achievement points after adventures and may use awards or penalties for exceptional play. Source: Gamemaster Guide p. 112-114.

items.name: Action Check Bonus
items.summary: Improves the hero's action check situation die by 1 step, such as +d0 becoming -d4.
items.reference: Player's Handbook p. 127-128; Table P29 p. 128.

items.name: Action Check Increase
items.summary: Increases the hero's action check score by 1 point each time it is purchased.
items.reference: Player's Handbook p. 127-128; Table P29 p. 128.

items.name: Extra Action
items.summary: Increases the hero's actions per round by 1, to a maximum of 4.
items.reference: Player's Handbook p. 127-128; Table P29 p. 128.
